runtime/x509#

The native layer under crypto/x509/certificate, crypto/x509/trust: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under crypto/x509/certificate, crypto/x509/trust: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Public API#

native certificate_facts#

native certificate_facts(origin is @byte) is string

Private immutable snapshot ABI. Parsing is deterministic; system_certificates explicitly reads host CA sources. No live certificate/key pointers escape.

native certificate_times#

native certificate_times(facts is string) is @string

notBefore and notAfter of the decoded facts.
